structural_change: p3 NATIVE LAUNCH FIX: p2 CLOSED (TT +234.41/FF +11.48/DRC0) but native audit FAILED 47 bc_hr_q launches max 274.3 ps vs 220: path = 163 ps clock insertion + 115 ps DFFASRHQNx1 clk->QN (149 ps slew, x1 async-reset flop driving the pin wire) + 5 hold pads (FF hold slack +120 ps on bc_hr_q[488]). Structural: the output stage hr1 loses its async reset (hr0 keeps it, so outputs are 0 one edge after reset assertion, before release) -> plain DFF output registers, reset loads 1,220 -> 610; same 2 fixed edges, no compiler change, same outline/faces/pins. | COMMON CAUSE (10-15, bc0 w1 / headp p1 / align p1 all GRT-0116): wide output buses packed into one dense band of a face (auto pin placement clusters a bus where its flops sit: headp hq at the S-east 30 um, 600 GCells) plus two recipe-2 output hold pads per output pin in that band (align: 33k outhold/bt_d_q/bc_hr_q overflow at the N band). Fix in all three kits: explicit even spreading of every face (tools/ref_tile/spread_face_pins.py, legal M3/M5 alternating N/S, M4 W/E) and no output hold pads (q/hq launch from pin flops; the die receivers carry their own input hold stages). | align height 43.2 -> 64.8 for the two 1,634-flop stages. | 10-15 S-ELEM-B: new fixed two-stage alignment leaf (physical_request.json): the unchanged IX data (bt_d 1024) and CTL broadcast (bc_hr 610) are delayed 2 fixed edges to meet the pipelined QB response; core stays wires-only. Own clock entry ck_qb_align (4d2d3b849). Pin-limited (1,634 b per face). | gate p0 (129.6 wide, 12.6 pins/um) GPL-0305 diverged and reset fan-out 1,220 > 256: reset split into 5 relay regions (244 loads each, release unchanged), width 172.8 = the closed BC slice pin density (9.5 pins/um).
